title.narrative: MAPUTO ACCORD FOR PEACE AND RECONCILIATION 2020/24

description.narrative: Ireland has supported the Peace Process Secretariat since 2017 when the Swiss Embassy provided administrative support. Following the signing of the Maputo Accord and the appointment of the UN Personal Envoy of the Secretary General, administrative support transitioned to UNOPS in January 2020. The overall goal of this project is to assure the full implementation of the Maputo Accord for Peace and Reconciliation. Consequently, contribute to a future of peace and reconciliation in Mozambique with no resurgence of military hostilities between the Government and Renamo.With disarmament and demobilisation activities now finalised, the key areas of focus for 2024 will be reinsertion activities to continue in a period of a year from the date of demobilisation while reintegration is underway. The timeline for reintegration is focused on the medium to long term, with particular prioritisation of activities related to pension attribution for DDR beneficiaries, which is expected to be finalised in 2024.
